meta.label_note: label codes as in the data; MISREPRESENTED = MISLEADING in the paper

agreement.note: R1 = the only human annotator (D17); weighted = phase design weights; CIs = two-stage cluster bootstrap, 2,000 reps, seed 20261110

calibration_kappa_R1_R2_dev.source: prereg D2 (calibration before the main study)

agreement.H6: not tested (D17 c: one human annotator)
agreement.annotation_time_note: self-reported by the human annotator for all 686 items (S-H 162 claims + phase 2 344 + edit check 180), about 0.6-0.7 min per item; per-pair minutes not recorded (logs/annotation_time.md)

H7.llm_rule: best dev macro-F1 under C2 among the four test LLMs (runs/dev_choice/cost_test.csv, before the test runs)

H1.what: design-weighted share MIS / (CON + MIS), random sample; null 0.5, SESOI 0.6
H1.note: 15 error claims raw (13 MIS, 2 CON); undefined reps 2

H2.what: penalised weighted logistic regression, OR(rewritten vs copied); null 1, SESOI 1.5

H3.what: penalised weighted logistic regression, OR(headline vs body); null 1, SESOI 1.5

H4.what: paired difference of macro-F1 on the random-sample C2-eligible claims (C0->C1, C1->C2), 4 systems x 2 = 8 tests; SESOI 0.05

H5.what: natural MIS recall minus post-stratified recall on R1-accepted distortion edits, per LLM under C2; SESOI -0.05

H7.what: macro-F1(selected LLM, C2) - macro-F1(nested-CV selected encoder) on identical pooled out-of-fold claims; SESOI 0.05

H6.why: D17 (c): only one human annotator; PSA_MIS(R1, R2) on S-H cannot be computed
